description: This file implements an Android activity named DeviceControlActivity which manages the user interface and interactions for a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) device, including connecting, displaying data, and handling GATT services and characteristics.

classes.name: DeviceControlActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity for controlling and interacting with a BLE device, including connecting, disconnecting, and displaying GATT services and data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds UI components, retrieves device info from intent, and starts service binding.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers broadcast receiver and attempts BLE connection if service is available.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters broadcast receiver to avoid leaks.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unbinds from the BluetoothLeService and cleans up resources.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu and adjusts connect/disconnect options based on connection status.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions like connect, disconnect, and navigation.

methods.name: updateConnectionState
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect current connection state.

methods.name: displayData
methods.description: Displays received data from BLE device.

methods.name: displayGattServices
methods.description: Processes and displays GATT services and characteristics in the UI.

methods.name: clearUI
methods.description: Clears the user interface elements related to GATT data.

methods.name: makeGattUpdateIntentFilter
methods.description: Creates an intent filter to listen for Bluetooth GATT update actions.
